stem.text: An object of weight $W$ is suspended from a newton meter. When the object is completely immersed in water, the newton meter reads $P$. When the object is completely immersed in oil, the newton meter reads $Q$.

stem.alt: Newton meter holding an object fully immersed in a beaker of water, with the reading labelled P.
Newton meter holding an object fully immersed in a beaker of oil, with the reading labelled Q.

stem.text: What is the ratio $\dfrac{\text{density of oil}}{\text{density of water}}$?
